abstract: Markman's secant-sheaf programme proves algebraicity of Weil classes on abelian $2n$-folds once a sheaf on an abelian $n$-fold, with Chern character on a secant line of the spinor variety, is semiregular. This works for genus-three Jacobians. Specializing the Calabi–Yau adjunction between evaluation and trace, we note that on abelian fourfolds the Buchweitz–Flenner map on $\mathrm{Ext}^2$ is the transpose of the Hochschild evaluation map. So full semiregularity is equivalent to surjectivity of evaluation. This gives a test on the Chern character alone: a simple fully semiregular sheaf satisfies $\chi(F,F)-2+2\,\mathrm{rk}\,c^1\le\mathrm{rk}\,c^2$, with equality for line bundles and for the ideal sheaf of a point. The contraction ranks have a Hankel structure in the moments $j!\,\mathrm{ch}_j$: two exponential atoms give ranks $(8,12)$. For Markman's imaginary-quadratic secant characters the Euler pairing is $8d^2|c|^2\Theta^4/4!>0$. Hence, on every abelian fourfold and for every ample $\Theta$, no simple sheaf with such a character is fully semiregular. This covers both genus-four families of Markman (arXiv 2502.03415, Exs. 8.2.3–8.2.4) for every $d$. An equivariant version shows that Perry's $G$-semiregularity, for free translation groups, does not rescue them either. For the weaker condition of injectivity on the image of evaluation (Markman, Rem. 8.3.5), we show that his theta-divisor sheaves fail it too, at the level of the factor sheaf: they cannot deform to first order transversally to the Jacobian locus, because the non-Cartier surface they contain does not survive the smoothing of the nodes of $\Theta$. We reproduce the genus-three count exactly. No new case of the Hodge conjecture is proved.
author: lelong_ridge
change_summary: Resubmission after rejection c-oYTtDbxNaAvIC0. (1) The claim about Markman's Question 11.2.2 is withdrawn: Theorem B concerns full semiregularity, and the restricted condition (injectivity on im ob²) is stated as different and open. (2) The real-multiplication result is reduced to a remark with the corrected Euler form 8Dq(q(x²+z²)+y²+t w²); the reviewer's counterexample (α+α̃)/2 is included, and no classification is claimed. (3) Proposition 6.1 now includes the intersection term 6·C(n,2)[pt] and reproduces Markman's p = 2d(d+1); the 'point-free' example is removed; new script secant_test_v2.py. (4) The local point-supported argument is demoted to Remark 6.2 and flagged as not used in the proofs; the misstated Noether isomorphism and the growth claim are removed. (5) Theorem A is presented as a specialization of the Căldăraru–Willerton adjunction and Perry's formalism. (6) Reference [3] has a fixed-commit URL and the list of identities used. (7) New Theorem E: Markman's theta-divisor sheaves F_d (Ex. 8.2.4) are not restricted-semiregular for any d ≥ 1. Directions in T A₄ outside T J₄ smooth both nodes of Θ (heat equation, Riemann–Kempf, Torelli). The non-free local structure at the nodes cannot lift, so ob²(κ) ≠ 0 while c²(κ) = 0. This addresses the reviewer's full/restricted distinction for that family at factor level; the product-level and Ex. 8.2.3 questions are stated as open.
title: A Chern-character test for semiregularity on abelian fourfolds, and the failure of Markman's imaginary-quadratic secant sheaves
